EmailTemplate.description: Sent to the applicant when JKP rejects a channel partner registration (Partner Registration Setting: Rejection Email Template). [[Reason]] stands for the approver's comment. Without a comment the part between <!--reason--> and <!--/reason--> is left out, and in the text version the line that holds [[Reason]].
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Registration Rejected
EmailTemplate.subject: Your John Keells Properties channel partner registration
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.Name},
Thank you for registering {!Account.Name} as a channel partner with John Keells Properties.
After reviewing your application, we are unable to approve it at this time.
Reason: [[Reason]]
If you have any questions, please contact the JKP CP team.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
